data.title: AMC CEO Adam Aron Criticizes Robinhood Stock Tokens and Meme Coins
data.description: AMC CEO Adam Aron again criticized Robinhood stock tokens and related meme coins traded on the platform, calling the products "shameless" and saying some meme coins may involve trademark infringement. According to Odaily, Aron also said AMC has recovered more than 1,600 movie tickets from resale platforms and warned ticket scalpers that AMC is tracking them.

data.title: South Korea Petition Over Crypto Tax Delay Tops 50,000 Signatures
data.description:
A South Korean national petition calling for a delay to virtual asset taxation has surpassed the 50,000-signature threshold required for parliamentary review. According to ChainCatcher, the petition will now be submitted to the relevant standing committee for formal deliberation and debate under South Korea’s legislative process.

The petition asks lawmakers to postpone the planned start of crypto taxation from January 2027 to 2029, arguing that tax-tracking infrastructure, cost-basis standards, and cross-platform data integration remain incomplete. Supporters said launching the tax in 2027 could increase filing burdens for retail investors and raise the risk of calculation errors, potentially driving capital outflows and weakening domestic liquidity.

The petition’s success also highlights the political balance facing South Korean lawmakers, who must weigh tax revenue needs against the concerns of a large base of active crypto investors. If parliament approves the delay, it would mark another major concession in South Korea’s rollout of crypto tax policy.

data.title: CryptoQuant Analyst Says Bitcoin Is Breaking Out As LTH SOPR Rises Above 1
data.description:
CryptoQuant analyst CW8900 said Bitcoin is breaking out from a bottom and entering an uptrend as long-term holders' spent output profit ratio, or SOPR, rises above 1. According to ChainCatcher, he said the market has shifted from a bearish phase to neutral, and a broader upward trend has begun.

He added that SOPR has not yet exceeded 6 in this cycle, while historical cycle tops usually form in that range. CW8900 said this suggests long-term holders have not yet entered a profit-taking phase and that the real bull market rally has not happened. He said earlier conditions were only preparation for the current move, with long-term holder positions at record highs and still increasing until recently. He expects the true rally to begin now, with the cycle top appearing in the profit-taking zone above SOPR 6.

data.title: U.S. Justice Department Seeks To Seize $61 Million Tied To Iran Oil Sales
data.description:
The U.S. Justice Department is seeking to seize $61 million that it says came from Iran's black-market oil sales and was laundered through crypto exchange Binance, Bloomberg reported.

Binance has not been accused of wrongdoing. A company representative did not immediately comment on the matter.

data.title: South Korea's Finance Minister Nominee Pledges Price Stability and Growth
data.description: According to Sina Finance, South Korea's finance and economy minister nominee Lee Hyeong-il said at a parliamentary confirmation hearing that he would prioritize price stability and stronger economic recovery, while seeking new growth engines and measures to bolster the country's ability to respond to global risks. He also said that, with consumption and employment improving, 3% economic growth this year is within reach, and that per capita national income is expected to exceed $40,000. Lee said the government will closely monitor risks including conditions in the chip industry, global interest-rate changes, and capital flows to prevent excessive market volatility. He added that South Korea will use its inclusion in the World Government Bond Index as a basis to seek entry into the MSCI developed market index and promote the internationalization of the won.

data.title: U.S. House Committee To Review Reserve Modernization Bill On September 16
data.description:
The U.S. House Financial Services Committee will conduct a line-by-line review of the Reserve Modernization Act on September 16. According to Foresight News, the bill was introduced on May 21 by Alaska Republican Representative Nick Begich, with Maine Democratic Representative Jared Golden as a co-sponsor.

The legislation aims to consolidate digital assets held by the U.S. government and protect them as reserve assets from arbitrary disposal by Congress or future administrations. Proceeds from the sale or conversion of non-Bitcoin assets could be used to buy additional Bitcoin or reduce the national debt. The bill would also require the Treasury Department and the Commerce Department to study budget-neutral strategies for acquiring additional Bitcoin over five years, while stating that the provision does not authorize borrowing, new taxes, or deficit spending to fund purchases.

data.title: Russian Central Bank Flags Crypto as Financial Market Risk
data.description:
Russia's central bank has listed cryptocurrencies as a financial market risk in its review of the main directions for Russia's financial market development in 2027 and 2028 to 2029. According to ChainCatcher, the bank said it is concerned that Russians are increasingly using stablecoins and other digital assets as substitutes for the national currency.

The central bank said investing in digital currencies carries a risk of total loss and that there is no responsible party or guarantee. It also said cryptocurrencies circulate outside individual jurisdictions, reducing the effectiveness of state restrictions and bans, while the lack of unified global regulation creates conditions for shadow market growth. The bank proposed criminal liability for those organizing digital currency circulation without permission and administrative penalties for legal market participants that violate the rules.

data.title: Solana Transaction V1 Goes Live on Mainnet
data.description:
Solana client development team Anza said on X that Transaction V1, also known as SIMD-0385, has gone live on mainnet. According to ChainCatcher, the upgrade raises the maximum transaction size from 1,232 bytes to 4,096 bytes, allowing ZK proofs, large multisignature transactions, BLS signatures, and confidential transfers that previously required multiple transactions to be completed in a single atomic operation.

The update also moves resource requests such as compute unit limits, priority fees, loaded account data size, and heap size into the transaction header instead of submitting them through compute budget instructions.

data.title: Elizabeth Warren Plans Senate Speech Criticizing CLARITY Act
data.description:
U.S. Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren plans to deliver a Senate speech criticizing the CLARITY Act. According to Foresight News, her prepared remarks say the bill's latest ethics provisions are a weak fig leaf and cannot stop U.S. President Donald Trump from continuing to profit from crypto businesses.

The remarks say the enforcement mechanism would be controlled by politically appointed officials, contains major loopholes, and would not apply to Trump's new bank. They also say the bill would expand his crypto footprint and strengthen links between USD1 and the U.S. financial system.

data.title: U.S. Senators Discuss AI Safety Bill Requiring Companies to Prove Reasonable Precautions
data.description:
U.S. Senate negotiators are discussing legislation that would require artificial intelligence companies to prove they are taking reasonable precautions to prevent their tools from causing harm. The proposal would give the U.S. Commerce Secretary authority to require developers to show they have taken reasonable steps to prevent harm and would authorize government auditors to test related products.

According to ChainCatcher, Reuters said the talks are still ongoing and it could not immediately determine what would qualify as reasonable. The proposal faces significant hurdles even if Congress approves it, as U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday that existing powers are sufficient to regulate and prosecute technology companies and suggested he would not sign a bill creating new AI rules.

Senate Majority Leader John Thune, Senate Commerce Committee Chairman Ted Cruz, and Democratic Senator Amy Klobuchar are among those discussing the proposal. Thune said on Monday that Congress can set guardrails for more serious threats without undermining the U.S. lead in the AI race.

Klobuchar said in a statement that she continues to push bipartisan legislation for government oversight of the biggest risks posed by AI models, including requiring developers to work with government experts to verify and test models for safety. Senate Commerce Committee ranking Democrat Maria Cantwell is also involved in the discussions.

Reuters reported on Friday that negotiators are also considering a federal court process that would let companies challenge a government decision to block the release of certain AI models if officials deem them unsafe. The court-related portion would also prevent states from enforcing their own laws targeting specific risks from AI models.

data.title: PONS Says 31% of Total Supply Has Been Burned
data.description: Pons said on X that 31% of PONS's total supply has been burned, including 1% burned within one week. According to Odaily, the statement did not provide additional details.

data.title: The Standard Reserve Raises 583.6 ETH in Genesis Charters Mint
data.description:
The Standard Reserve said it has completed its Genesis Charters mint and raised 583.6 ETH. According to ChainCatcher, the mint price for whitelist participants was 0.15 ETH, while most public auction sales cleared between 1.23 ETH and 1.25 ETH.

The project said all proceeds will go entirely to initial liquidity and the protocol treasury, with no allocation to the team. STANDARD briefly reached a market capitalization of $18.38 million and was at $17.06 million at the time of reporting. The token used a temporary anti-sniping tax during its first hour of trading, starting at 90% and decaying exponentially, with most of the reduction occurring in the first five minutes before normal trading fees resumed after one hour.

data.title: Derive Community Proposes Deploying V3 and Phasing Out Derive Chain
data.description: The Derive community has released a proposal to deploy V3 and gradually shut down Derive Chain. According to Foresight News, the proposal includes launching Derive V3, migrating all V2 positions and balances to V3's genesis state, and moving cross-chain funds to L1 before phasing out Derive Chain.

data.title: Mike Novogratz Says U.S. Could Lose Crypto Regulation If Clarity Act Stalls
data.description: Mike Novogratz said on X that if the Clarity Act does not advance tomorrow, the U.S. could be unable to secure crypto regulation for a long time, or even permanently. According to Odaily, he said this would hurt the U.S. and push more of the industry overseas, adding that the digital and blockchain revolution will continue and urging bipartisan senators to focus on the bigger picture.

data.title: a16z Partner Josh Elman Says Product Management Is Storytelling
data.description:
a16z partner Josh Elman said product management is about storytelling, recalling that he began his career as an engineer at RealNetworks and worked on the product and engineering teams for RealPlayer, which had hundreds of millions of users. According to ChainCatcher, he said he was later interviewed by Reid Hoffman for LinkedIn and was asked what a product manager’s output is; he first answered a specification document, but later said that was the wrong answer and that the real output is a story people can pass along without him present.

Elman said he once wrote a 120-page specification document at LinkedIn. He added that AI has collapsed the cost of making products and reversed the development loop, shifting the process from specifications and scope to building and experience. He said teams should use AI to quickly build prototypes, see how they feel, and then design and release after the prototype proves better than assumptions.

He also said demos are now nearly free while working products are not, making decisions about what to build a debate over influence. Elman said vision consists of purpose, core actions, and cycles, and that teams should ask whether people are truly using the product. He added that guiding users is the most important moment in storytelling.
